purpose: Separate xv6 diagnostic-runner overhead from the machine hot path; no emulator code changed

workload.name: stock xv6-public forktest, 4 MiB, Bochs BIOS
workload.command: XV6_FIRMWARE=bochs XV6_STEPS=40000000 XV6_STOP_ON_EXPECT=1 XV6_COMMAND=$'forktest\r' XV6_EXPECT_SERIAL=$'fork test OK\n$ ' node scripts/probe-xv6-stock.mjs

guestEquality.errorContextDifference: The lean mode also omits the per-step recent-instruction ring, so a thrown exception has less context.

conclusion: The mean lean run used 26.36 rather than 27.88 user CPU seconds (1.058x). This is only diagnostic-runner overhead, not faster emulation. Use lean mode for future full-guest performance A/B and normal mode when milestone or fault-context records are needed. One normal run and two lean runs are not a broad host-variance study.
